conviction_note: Q3 revenue very likely lands at or above the $611M guide midpoint (Globant has landed in the upper half of or above its revenue guide on each of the last three prints), but this stock trades on the guide, and the public bear case (Guggenheim, 11 Nov: a large gaming client and the Middle East weakening, Q4 flat YoY, possible sequential drop in Q1 2027) points to a soft Q4/2027 outlook. That sits against a crowded short (about 25% of shares out, 10.7 days to cover), a -12% five-day run-in and calls priced above puts. The findings sum to +0.7 because the squeeze mechanism outweighs the shrunk, mostly priced negatives. The scaled number is slightly negative because 4 of the last 6 prints sold off hard on guidance. The two measurements disagree mildly in sign, and that gap is the honest state of the evidence.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue $607-615M (company guide, 6-K of 2026-08-13, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001557860/000110465926095916/tm2623064d1_ex99-1.htm). Consensus is $611.1M per Earnings Whispers via https://finviz.com/news/421349/globants-ai-pods-must-outrun-a-shrinking-core-after-a-guidance-cut-and-restructuring and $610.9M per Benzinga, so two sources agree. Adjusted EPS guide is $1.43-1.53. The EPS consensus is disputed: $1.47 (Earnings Whispers), $1.48 (GuruFocus), $1.41-1.52 (Benzinga), against $1.13 in the sweep row's Nasdaq calendar entry, which is probably a different basis. The EPS bar is treated as the company guide. The guide-implied Q4 is FY $2,428-2,462M less H1 $1,221.5M (Q1 $607.1M + Q2 $614.4M) less Q3, which gives a midpoint of about $612.5M, flat against Q4 2025's $612.5M (https://www.bloomberglinea.com/latinoamerica/argentina/globant-sube-en-after-market-tras-superar-expectativas-de-facturacion-en-el-cuarto-trimestre/).
positioning_check: Equibles (https://equibles.com/stocks/glob/shortinterest, read 2026-11-19): 10,995,198 shares short at the 2026-10-30 FINRA settlement, up 2.48M from 8.52M on 10-15, about 25.5% of 43.18M shares outstanding, 10.65 days to cover, squeeze-screen score 87/100. The Sep 30 peak was 11.87M (27.8% of float, 13.2 days to cover, per a MarketBeat snippet). The Nov 13 settlement is not yet published (due Nov 24). Borrow fee is about 0.4% (curvedtrading snippet, July 2026), so the stock is easy to borrow. In the baseline, 25d skew is -29.65 vol points (calls bid over puts, 'upside paid'), put/call OI is 1.11, and the event straddle is 13.35%. The stock closed $40.22 on 11-19 (-5.71% that day), -12% over 5 sessions, -43% from its 52-week high, and about 8x Guggenheim's 2027 EPS. This is a crowded short into the print with options leaning up.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue is likely to land at or above the $611M guide midpoint and the $611.1M consensus. Globant beat or reached the upper half of its own revenue guide on each of the last three prints: Q4 2025 $612.5M against the guide and against $605.7M Bloomberg consensus; Q1 2026 $607.1M against a $598-604M guide; Q2 2026 $614.4M against a $610-616M guide. That suggests a print around $613-616M, about +0.3% to +0.8% against the bar, which is still inside the guided range.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue beats have not paid. Q1 2026 beat the top of its guide and the stock moved about -1% to -2%. Q2 2026 came in near the top of its guide and the stock fell 14-17% on the guide cut. Q4 2025 beat consensus with an in-line guide and rose about 3% after hours.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced, because the company's beat habit is visible to anyone. If the market expected a material beat, consensus would sit above the guide midpoint rather than at $611.1M, and a whisper would be above $1.52. The whisper EPS is $1.52, at the top of the EPS guide, so part of this is already in the whisper.
findings.independence: The track record comes from the company's own 6-Ks plus Bloomberg Línea for Q4 2025 (https://www.bloomberglinea.com/latinoamerica/argentina/globant-sube-en-after-market-tras-superar-expectativas-de-facturacion-en-el-cuarto-trimestre/). EPAM, a peer that reported after Globant last spoke, also landed above the top of its Q3 guide (https://www.morningstar.com/news/pr-newswire/20261105ph89788/epam-reports-results-for-third-quarter-2026).

findings.finding: Guggenheim (Jonathan Lee) cut GLOB to Neutral from Buy on 2026-11-11 and withdrew its $50 target. It cited further Middle East weakness, a possible scale-back by a large unnamed video-game client, subdued bookings, Q4 revenue roughly flat YoY, and a possible sequential decline in Q1 2027 that could make 2027 revenue shrink YoY. The sell side's bar for the Q4 guide and the first 2027 commentary is therefore flat to down, not growth.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance is the line this stock trades on. The Q2 2026 FY cut (Q3 guided $607-615M against $624.6M consensus) brought -14% to -17%. The Q3 2025 print brought -9% to -15%. The Q2 2025 FY trim brought -14%. The in-line Q4 2025 guide brought about +3%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced. The stock fell about 5% on the note and is -12% over the five sessions into the print. The open part is whether the company confirms the gaming-client loss and guides Q4 below the roughly $612.5M its FY range implies. If the market fully believed a 2027 decline, the options would not be paying up for calls (skew -29.65).
findings.independence: Goldesel (https://goldesel.de/aktien/news/globant-aktie-analyst-stuft-auf-neutral-ab-und-streicht-kursziel, 2026-11-11) reports the same note in more detail (about 8x 2027 EPS, possible Q1 2027 sequential decline). It shares one source, so it counts once. Cognizant's 2026-10-29 trim of FY growth to 4.0-4.4% with bookings -7% YoY (https://yourstory.com/enterprise-story/2026/10/cognizant-records-46-rise-in-revenues-in-q3-but-lowers-annual-growth-guidance) points the same way for the sector.

findings.finding: Disney, cited by analysts (Piper Sandler) as a source of client headwinds and historically one of Globant's largest accounts (Globant's top customer is 8.9% of revenue), reported on 2026-11-17, two days before Globant. Disney's new management targets $3B of annual run-rate savings by FY2029, and its CFO said savings will come from administrative and general expenses, IT and real-estate consolidation and shared services, with more layoffs expected. That is a counterparty read on 2027 vendor spend.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior Globant reaction to a Disney disclosure was found. Globant's guide reactions are listed in the Guggenheim finding.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly unpriced. Disney spoke after Globant last guided, and the IT-consolidation wording is buried in the call rather than the headline. Disney also named technology as a growth area (new CTO, an AI planning tool built with Google), so the transmission is ambiguous. GLOB fell about 11% between 11-16 and 11-19, which could partly reflect this, but no source ties the two.
findings.independence: A proxy: it is not confirmed that Disney is the 8.9% customer in 2026. The IT-consolidation quote is from search-summary coverage. The stockanalysis.com write-up (https://stockanalysis.com/news/dis-q4-fy2026-earnings/) confirms the $3B savings and 'more layoffs' from A&G but not the IT wording.

findings.finding: Electronic Arts, the likely 'large video-game client' in the Guggenheim note (not confirmed), went private on 2026-08-04 under PIF, Silver Lake and Affinity with about $20bn of debt. Before closing it cut staff three times in 2026, including internal IT in June, with an internal email saying work would move to 'different teams, locations, or service partners'. The sign for an outsourcer is ambiguous: debt-driven cost cuts against work moving to vendors.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior reaction to an EA disclosure was found.
findings.why_not_priced: The EA-Globant link is inference. The call may name or size the gaming-client change, which would make it visible. It is partly priced through the Guggenheim note.
findings.independence: The June 2026 EA IT cuts and the 'service partners' wording are from https://godisageek.com/2026/06/ea-layoffs-support-recruitment-it/. It overlaps with the Guggenheim finding (the same client concern), so it is kept small to avoid double-counting.

findings.finding: Peer prints since Globant last spoke are mixed-to-constructive. EPAM (2026-11-05) beat the top of its Q3 guide ($1.426bn against $1.410-1.425bn), raised FY non-GAAP EPS to $13.23-13.31, guided Q4 to -0.2% to +0.9% YoY, added $1.5bn of buyback, and rose about 7%. Cognizant (2026-10-29) trimmed FY constant-currency growth to 4.0-4.4% from 4-5.5% and reported bookings -7%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The market rewarded EPAM's beat, flat guide and buyback with +7%, so a flat guide from an IT-services name was not punished this season.
findings.why_not_priced: EPAM's reaction shows the market will pay for 'flat but stabilising plus capital return' in this sector. GLOB has fallen since, so the peer read has not lifted it, which suggests it is either unpriced for GLOB or discounted on GLOB-specific concerns.
findings.independence: Cognizant (https://yourstory.com/enterprise-story/2026/10/cognizant-records-46-rise-in-revenues-in-q3-but-lowers-annual-growth-guidance) points the other way. The two are netted here.

findings.finding: The short is crowded and building into the print. About 11.0M shares are short (2026-10-30 settlement, +2.48M from 10-15), roughly 25.5% of shares outstanding and 10.7 days to cover. The stock is -12% in five sessions into the print. The option market prices calls over puts (25d skew -29.65). Any outlook that is not cut (Q4 at or above the roughly $612.5M implied, or a credible AI Pods ARR path to the $110M exit) gives a squeeze mechanism.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the Q2 2026 low (about $35 post-print), the stock rallied to a post-earnings high of $50.19 (+40%) with short interest near peak, which shows short-covering capacity. The in-line Q4 2025 guide brought +3% after hours.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is the market's own state, not a fact it can miss. What is unpriced is the asymmetry: with the bear case (flat Q4, Q1 2027 dip) already published and sold into, a guide that merely matches it leaves shorts with little left to gain over 10+ days of volume to cover.
findings.independence: The baseline's sealed skew of -29.65 (upside paid) and the Sep 30 MarketBeat figure (27.8% of float, 13.2 days to cover) come from different sources and point the same way.

findings.finding: Globant had $125.0M left under its new buyback authorization at 2026-06-30, about 7% of the current roughly $1.84B market cap, after completing the prior program with $25M in Q2. Q3 repurchases at sub-$50 prices, or an upsized program, would be disclosed in the release. The balance sheet limits this: about $422M of borrowings against $168.8M of cash.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Bloomberg Línea reported a buyback launched in reaction to an earlier share-price fall (undated in the snippet). EPAM's buyback push this season coincided with +7%.
findings.why_not_priced: The authorization is public. Whether it was used in Q3 is not. It is small relative to the guide line.

findings.finding: The Argentine peso has appreciated in real terms. It weakened only about 6% against the dollar over the year to September 2026 against 33-34% annual inflation (September CPI +1.9% m/m), so Globant's Argentine wage costs rise in dollar terms. That pressures the 13.5-14.5% Q3 adjusted operating margin guide after Q2's 13.2% and four straight quarters of gross-margin decline (36.5%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 gross margin of 37% (currency a drag) and Q2's 13.2% operating margin, below target, came with the -1% to -2% and -14% to -17% prints respectively, but neither was the headline driver.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly in the guide, since management set the margin guide knowing the peso path. The margin miss risk is a macro-to-company inference the company has not confirmed for Q3. Restructuring (Q3 charges guided at $20-25M, plus a 150-person ERE in Spain, https://www.que.es/2026/09/19/ere-globant-espana-malaga/) offsets on cost.

findings.finding: The Saudi giga-project slowdown persisted through H1 2026: Q1 2026 Saudi contract awards fell 51% YoY to $11bn, the Red Sea project was paused, and the PIF 2026-30 strategy focuses on delivering existing projects. Globant's New Markets segment (5.5% of revenue, top country Saudi Arabia) fell about 18% in Q2, and management already assumes the weakness persists in its guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Roughly half of the Q2 2026 FY guide cut was attributed to New Markets, and that print fell 14-17%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced and inside the guide. At 5.5% of revenue, a further 20% drop is about 1% of group revenue. The rest of the company (North America 52.8%, top 50 clients growing 6.9% in Q2) would have to slip for this to matter. Guggenheim's 'additional Middle East weakness' is the only sign it got worse.
findings.independence: Segment share and decline: Q2 6-K and https://finviz.com/news/421349/globants-ai-pods-must-outrun-a-shrinking-core-after-a-guidance-cut-and-restructuring. It shares the Middle East theme with the Guggenheim finding.

findings.finding: Glob.AI ARR was $52.8M at Q2 (up 61% QoQ) against a company target of at least $110M exiting 2026, which needs roughly a doubling in six months. Preview coverage puts the credibility line for the Q3 figure in the high-$70M range. No Q3 data point was found, so this is a sourced bar with no read on which side it lands.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 2026 ARR jump (+61%) was released alongside the guide cut, and the stock still fell 14-17%. AI metrics have not offset guidance so far.
findings.why_not_priced: Unknown in either direction. It is filed so the judges see the second bar the call will be held to.
findings.independence: The finviz preview gives the high-$70M threshold (https://finviz.com/news/421349/globants-ai-pods-must-outrun-a-shrinking-core-after-a-guidance-cut-and-restructuring).

outside_window.finding: The FINRA short-interest settlement for 2026-11-13 is published around 2026-11-24, after the exit window. The Equibles model forecasts 10.89M shares (-0.9%).

Guggenheim's possible sequential revenue decline in Q1 2027 resolves with the Q4 2026 print in February 2027. Only the commentary on it reaches this window, and that is filed under the Guggenheim finding.

baseline_tension: The fundamental negatives (soft Q4/2027 outlook, gaming client, Middle East, Disney savings) agree with the -12% run-in and are largely what the stock has already sold on. They cut against the upside-paid skew (-29.65) and a 25%-of-shares crowded short, so the negatives were shrunk and p_up was left near 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1/6 (a revenue beat inside the guide; this name does not pay for quarter beats): the Q3 revenue finding was cut from +1.0 to +0.5.

Lesson 7 (negatives against a strong upside skew and a 25%-of-shares short): Guggenheim was cut from -1.5 to -1.0, EA from -0.5 to -0.3, ARS from -0.5 to -0.3 and Saudi from -0.3 to -0.2. p_up moved from 48 to 49.
Lesson 5 (proxy, transmission not confirmed by the counterparty): Disney was cut from -1.0 to -0.6.

Left standing: the positioning +2.0 (lesson 7 names a crowded short as a mechanism in its own right), peer +0.3, buyback +0.3, AI ARR 0.0 and abs_move 13 (the reaction distribution is large, so lesson 8 applies and nothing was shrunk).
